verificationEvidence.claim: WHAT: pollOnce reads a single page (limit PAGE_SIZE=500) and then unconditionally advances the cursor to pollStartedAt, and the new comment claiming page.hasMore is never true is false. WHY: EventsClient.listEvents documents that the provider caps the limit at 100 (events-client.ts:16), so any window containing more than 100 events returns hasMore=true and a non-null nextCursor; those events are never read and the stored cursor jumps past them, silently dropping invoice.paid/voided/payment_failed events for good (this revises the earlier round-a-P27-poller-first-page-only suggestion, whose claimed pagination fix is not present — the applied change only bumped the page size and added the incorrect comment). HOW: loop following nextCursor until hasMore is false, e.g.: let cursor: string | undefined; do { const page = await client.listEvents({ createdAfter: since, createdBefore: pollStartedAt, limit: PAGE_SIZE, cursor }); for (const event of page.data) { await handleEvent(invoices, event); } cursor = page.nextCursor ?? undefined; } while (cursor); await cursors.set(CURSOR_KEY, pollStartedAt);
